project: SpinDrift — Quantum Biosensors for Astronaut Health (NASA Space Apps 2026)

boundary_semantics.lower_is_worse: green if value > amber_boundary (or >= for correlation/cardiac_field lower bound); amber if red_boundary <= value <= amber_boundary; red if value < red_boundary
boundary_semantics.higher_is_worse: green if value < amber_boundary; amber if amber_boundary <= value <= red_boundary; red if value > red_boundary

threshold_adjustment_rule.note: Each unit of amber_offset or red_offset tightens allowed deviation from baseline by 5% (0% at LEO up to 30% in Deep Space), widening alert windows for earlier warning where radiation, isolation, or zero-rescue constraints apply.

sensor_environment_physics.serf_opm_relationship: SERF operation improves as ambient magnetic field drops: QuSpin QZFM and miniaturized OPM-MEG sensors require near-zero local fields (<50 nT residual) to eliminate spin-exchange relaxation. In LEO (~25-65 uT), heavy shielding or active triaxial nulling is required and orbital field gradients add noise; in cislunar, Mars transit, and deep space (nT to sub-nT ambient fields), shielding mass and compensation noise drop and OPMs reach peak sensitivity. At Europa, Jupiter's ~420 uT ambient field overwhelms standard SERF dynamic range and degrades OPM sensitivity.
sensor_environment_physics.nv_diamond_relationship: NV-diamond T1 relaxometry (532 nm excitation, 637-800 nm readout) and the NV-diamond cardiac magnetometer alternative operate across strong ambient magnetic fields at room temperature without a SERF zero-field lock, preserving monitoring resilience at Europa (~420 uT) when OPM channels degrade.

aggregation_rules.per_sensor_status: Worst status among all biomarkers mapped to that sensor (red > amber > green).

overall_crew_status.red: Any single biomarker in red, OR two or more biomarkers in amber accompanied by degraded sensor confidence requiring flight-surgeon review.
overall_crew_status.amber: One or more biomarkers in amber (and none in red), OR two or more sensors simultaneously showing amber across systems.

aggregation_rules.europa_degraded_mode: Under Europa's ~420 uT Jovian field, Chest QuSpin QZFM OPM is flagged degraded — switch primary cardiac tracking to the NV-diamond cardiac magnetometer alt (12 mm head, 6-26 pT/sqrt(Hz), arXiv 2601.18843) with signal-averaged QRS, rely on surviving actively compensated OPM-MEG channels for Head, and anchor systemic stress assessment on Finger NV-diamond T1 relaxometry.

iss.name: International Space Station (ISS)
iss.human_data_note: Extensive long-duration LEO human flight data; inflight continuous OPM/NV biomarker integration not yet clinically validated.

tiangong.name: Tiangong Space Station
tiangong.ambient_field_regime: LEO geomagnetic (~25-65 uT; ~390 km altitude, 41.5 deg inclination)
tiangong.human_data_note: Long-duration LEO crew experience exists; continuous quantum biosensor norms remain unvalidated in flight.

crew_dragon.note: Short duration; motion and radiation at higher orbit
crew_dragon.name: SpaceX Crew Dragon
crew_dragon.ambient_field_regime: LEO to high-apogee Earth orbit (~25-65 uT baseline; up to ~585-1,408 km on specialized flights)
crew_dragon.human_data_note: Short-duration LEO and high-altitude commercial crew data exist (e.g., Inspiration4 OSDR, Polaris Dawn).

orion.note: Cislunar radiation — widen windows for GCR exposure
orion.name: Orion Spacecraft (Cislunar)
orion.ambient_field_regime: Cislunar space outside magnetosphere (~1-10 nT solar wind IMF outside Van Allen transits)
orion.human_data_note: Short ~9-day crewed lunar flyby completed (Artemis II, Apr 2026); multi-week human cislunar data remain limited.

gateway.name: Lunar Gateway (NRHO)
gateway.ambient_field_regime: Outside Earth's magnetosphere in lunar NRHO (~1-10 nT IMF baseline)
gateway.human_data_note: No human crew has flown or inhabited Gateway.

lunar_base.note: 1/6 g bone and muscle loss; lunar dust ROS load
lunar_base.name: Lunar Base
lunar_base.ambient_field_regime: No global dipole (~2-10 nT IMF baseline; localized crustal anomalies ~100-300 nT)
lunar_base.human_data_note: Apollo surface stays were <=3 days; no human crew has lived at a long-duration lunar base.

mars_transit.note: Peak isolation, radiation, deconditioning — widest windows, earliest alerts
mars_transit.name: Mars Transit
mars_transit.human_data_note: No human crew has ever flown a Mars transit mission.

mars_surface.name: Mars Surface
mars_surface.ambient_field_regime: No global dipole (~2-10 nT induced baseline; strong localized crustal anomalies ~50 to >1,000 nT)
mars_surface.human_data_note: No human crew has ever landed on or lived on Mars.

europa.note: Degraded OPM sensitivity — rely on NV and surviving MEG channels
europa.name: Europa (Jovian System)
europa.ambient_field_regime: Jupiter magnetospheric field (~420 uT at Europa)
europa.human_data_note: No human crew has ever traveled to Europa or the Jovian system.

deep_space.note: No rescue, no resupply — autonomy-first logic
deep_space.name: Deep Space
deep_space.ambient_field_regime: Outer heliosphere / interstellar (<1 nT to few nT; ~0.1-0.5 nT in LISM)
deep_space.human_data_note: No human crew has ever operated in deep space beyond the Earth-Moon system.

chest_heart.alt_device_specs: 12 mm head, 6-26 pT/sqrt(Hz), measured real human hearts (arXiv 2601.18843, Jan 2026)

biomarkers.device_reads: Larmor precession shift in 87Rb vapor cell

amber.above_upper_bound_note: Values >65 pT flag amber to verify sensor standoff, motion artifact, or elevated amplitude.
amber.action: Increase MCG recording to daily. Compare QRS morphology to preflight baseline.

red.action: Continuous MCG monitoring. Flight surgeon consult within 24 h.

amber.action: Flag morphology change. Review QT interval.

red.action: Restrict strenuous activity. 12-lead ECG if available.

biomarkers.what_it_is: Natriuretic peptide A — released when heart wall stretches

amber.action: Heart adapting to microgravity. Monitor cardiac output.

red.action: Sustained cardiac overload. Restrict strenuous EVA. Flight surgeon within 24 h.

head_brain.device_specs: 12 x 16.5 x 22.5 mm per sensor, <7 fT/sqrt(Hz), 130 Hz bandwidth, 0.7 W per head; 49 to 128 channels (FieldLine HEDscan class); wearable

red.action: No EVA or vehicle ops. Mandatory 12 h stand-down.

biomarkers.what: Drowsiness and cognitive load; rises with fatigue

amber.action: Rest protocol. Daily psychomotor vigilance test.

red.action: Restrict mission-critical tasks. Notify flight surgeon.
Cognitive impairment risk. Restrict complex tasks.

finger_ras.device_specs: 532 nm excitation, 637-800 nm readout, ROS sensitivity 5.3 x 10^-13 M/sqrt(Hz); demonstrated in living cardiomyocytes

red.action: Hypovolemia. IV fluid protocol if available.

cardiac_field.degraded_sensor_note: OPM degraded by ~420 uT Jovian field; use NV-diamond cardiac alt (6-26 pT/sqrt(Hz)) with signal averaging.

qrs_morphology.degraded_sensor_note: Signal-average NV-diamond cardiac output before flagging morphology drift.

alpha_power.degraded_sensor_note: Use surviving actively compensated OPM-MEG channels.

theta_power.degraded_sensor_note: Use surviving actively compensated OPM-MEG channels.

drift_score.degraded_sensor_note: Cross-check surviving MEG channels with finger NV-diamond stress trend.
